headline: Taiwan Stocks Fall 586 Points on the Week; Listed Companies' Total Market Value Drops NT$1.9 Trillion to NT$147.8 Trillion | Securities
summary: Taiwan stocks fell 586.72 points, or 1.28%, this week, ending a two-week winning streak. Listed companies' total market value dropped nearly NT$1.9 trillion from last week.
why: The TAIEX is Taiwan's benchmark index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor makers, so its moves reflect the global chip cycle and regional risk sentiment.

impacts.name: TAIEX
impacts.why: The benchmark index fell 1.28% over the week, reducing listed market value by about NT$1.9 trillion.
